create_meteor_metric: create a METEOR metric instance to evaluate machine translation quality against references
compute_meteor_score: compute METEOR scores for translated segments against one or more reference translations
get_meteor_info: get METEOR metric metadata including description, citation, features, and reference URLs
download_meteor_resources: download required NLTK resources like wordnet, punkt, and omw-1.4 for METEOR computation
configure_meteor_parameters: configure METEOR scoring parameters alpha, beta, and gamma for precision, recall, and fragmentation weighting
